thread:
IncidentBot: [P1] high error/429 spike detected in hosted inference (canary) during rate-limit rollout. Alert id: RBW-2026-042. Auto-paged oncall.
Oncall-Bot: paging Jamie (oncall) — page sent to primary.
Jamie: on it, joining. can someone confirm which canary was promoted?" 
Alex: pushed rollout at 12:03 UTC to canary pool `canary-rlv3`. saw rollout flag flip: `rlv3-canary=true`.
Mina: seeing sustained 429s across canary at 12:05. snippet from proxy logs:
```
2026-03-15T12:05:12Z | req_id=abc123 | model=gpt-rlv3 | status=429 | reason=over-throttle | tokens=142
2026-03-15T12:05:14Z | req_id=abc124 | model=gpt-rlv3 | status=429 | reason=missing-exemption | account=acct_44
```
Sasha: digging — early sign: token accounting module dropped exemption header when upstream proxy used HTTP/2 connection pooling. new header parsing change in rollout reorders headers (`x-rw-exempt`) and our matcher didn't catch it.
Jamie: ok kill-switch time. Flip the canary flag off while we assess. Command:
```
/feature-toggle set rlv3-canary false --env=hosted
```
Jamie: executed kill-switch at 12:08 UTC. starting rollback of canary variant.
IncidentBot: rollback triggered, canary instances draining.
Paul: can we apply temporary exemptions for affected enterprise accounts while we fully revert? want to avoid paying customers seeing 429s.
Sasha: yes. run the admin exemption for the list. CLI snippet:
```
rl-admin add-exemption --account acct_44 --reason "temporary restore after canary regression"
rl-admin add-exemption --account acct_77 --reason "temp"
```
Daria: quick impact estimate — approx 2100 requests failed with 429s across 11 enterprise accounts between 12:04–12:08 UTC. customer-facing error rate peaked at 6.2% for hosted API.
Mina: metrics starting to drop after flag flip. token failure logs show token_mismatch entries too:
```
ERROR token_accounting: expected 0.0012, saw 0.0 header=x-rw-exempt
```
Jamie: flagged for postmortem, paging SRE lead (Alex) to join follow-up. For now: rollback + add exemptions + monitor.
Alex: filing a quick mitigation ticket: RBW-2026-042-MIT. I'll attach logs and affected hosts.
IncidentBot: monitoring: 429 rate down 88% over 5m since rollback — still watching.
Paul: customer comms — notify top 10 affected accounts with an incident bulletin. draft ready, will send after confirmation of stabilization.
Sasha: root cause hypothesis: header reordering in new proxy path + brittle header-matching code in token accounting. reproducer written, pushing test to CI to catch header-order variants.
Jamie: handoff to oncall next shift in 30m. Jamie -> Alex for postmortem coordination. anyone else?
Daria: I'll pull billing logs to estimate potential revenue impact and add to postmortem.
Oncall-Bot: escalation closed for primary, secondary paged for follow-up.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: canary rolled back, emergency exemptions applied, customer mitigation in progress. Incident severity downgraded to S2. Postmortem required, owner: Alex."
